description:
FILED s514e (Opus, 2026-10-10).  Compress::Raw::Zlib is XS (zlib itself) and has no PCL build, so Compress::Zlib, IO::Compress::Gzip, IO::Uncompress::Gunzip, IO::Zlib and Archive::Tar's compressed paths cannot load.  The production review's (s513) claim that they failed "only because of File::Glob" was wrong.  s514e shipped the File::Glob shim (#3160), and `use Compress::Zlib` now gets past File::GlobMapper and fails at Compress::Raw::Zlib.

MEASURED (s514e, tree on main 0d7c7ded + File::Glob shim): Raw::Zlib wraps `XSLoader::load` in an eval and falls back to `bootstrap Compress::Raw::Zlib`.  PCL's DynaLoader::bootstrap was a silent no-op, so the load "succeeded", and the first constant lookup went AUTOLOAD -> constant() (XS, missing) -> AUTOLOAD ... until SBCL died with "Binding stack exhausted".  s514e fixed that half: bootstrap now goes through XSLoader::load's p-xs-no-artifact path, so `use Compress::Zlib` dies in ONE line, "Can't locate Compress/Raw/Zlib.pm in @INC (the module is XS and has no PCL build ...)" (guard Pl/t/file-glob-shim-01.t).

THE MISSING PIECE is a Compress::Raw::Zlib for PCL: deflateInit/inflateInit stream objects (deflate, flush, inflate, inflateSync, status dualvars Z_OK/Z_STREAM_END/...), crc32, adler32, the constants, WindowBits incl. gzip/raw/auto, and the flags IO::Compress uses.  Three routes:
 (a) a PURE-PERL inflate/deflate shim in lib/Compress/Raw/Zlib.pm (the Digest pattern: correct and slow, portable).  Inflate is ~300 lines; a deflate that really compresses (LZ77 hash chains + fixed/dynamic Huffman) is ~400.  Byte-identical output to zlib is not required: callers compare round trips, never bytes.
 (b) libz through sb-alien: fast, small, but PLATFORM-TOUCHING -- ships only with the install matrix + a macOS leg green (USER rule, feedback_portability_os_matrix).
 (c) pclxs after the bug phase (the USER's stated route for XS, s514 #2949 ruling).
ACCEPTANCE: Fable's probe ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/review/p514e/gz.pl identical to perl (gzip/gunzip a 123 KB string round trip, memGzip/memGunzip, compress/uncompress, deflate/inflate stream, crc32 891568578 / adler32 38600999 of "abc", cross gzip->memGunzip, a bad header error).
The everyday row modules/Archive-Tar-Compress depends on THIS task AND #2590 (IO::Zlib ties *$fh); the baseline row is not edited until both land.


RULED by the USER (s516, 2026-10-12, asked by Fable): ROUTE (b) -- libz through sb-alien -- "for now", NOTED AS TEMPORARY: pclxs (route c) replaces it later if the bridge works.  Conditions (Fable): the shim is lib/Compress/Raw/Zlib.pm (the module's API: deflateInit / inflateInit stream objects, deflate / flush / inflate / inflateSync, the Z_* status dualvars, crc32 / adler32, WindowBits incl. gzip / raw / auto, the IO::Compress flags) and ONLY the calls into zlib live in the runtime as `builtin::`-style primitives (the s377 seam), each a define-alien-routine over `libz.so.1` (Linux) / `libz.dylib` (macOS) loaded at FIRST USE with a one-line perl-shaped die when the library is absent (never a backtrace); buffers pinned (sb-sys:with-pinned-objects), z_stream as an alien struct with platform word sizes; the TEMPORARY status is written at the top of the shim and in docs/shipped-modules.md + not-supported.md (what pclxs will replace, and why the alien route was taken: speed + byte-identical output); it ships only with the install matrix + a macOS leg green (feedback_portability_os_matrix; tools/t/install-container.t runs it).  Acceptance unchanged: the gz.pl probe identical to perl; IO-Compress's own t/ files as a board candidate; the everyday row modules/Archive-Tar-Compress waits for #2590 too.

=== DONE (s517b, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-16) ===
lib/Compress/Raw/Zlib.pm (the module's API, TEMPORARY top comment) over builtin::zlib_* primitives (one per zlib function) in cl/pcl-runtime.lisp; ONE host-library loader %p-host-library-p (first use, :dont-save, init-hook reset; crypt moved onto it).  Saved core: a fresh core build and an already-saved core both run the probes; nothing is loaded at core start, so a core saved with libz present starts on a box without it.  Acceptance: Fable's gz.pl / zl2.pl / zl3.pl IDENTICAL to perl (zl2 line `-MAX_WBITS` needed #3344).  It needed #2636 (copy-back, the Compress::Zlib `my $output` pattern) and five fixes found on the way: #3340 #3341 #3342 #3343 #3345.  verify.sh carries a gzip round trip.  Guard Pl/t/zlib-01.t (62 rows; skip_all naming the reason when libz is absent).  See the s517b session-log section for the census and the legs.

RULING (Fable, s518): the IO-Compress-2.214 census does NOT join the board -- 93 files at zero rows carry no information; it joins when #3346 (Test::NoWarnings + plan) is fixed.
subject: Compress::Raw::Zlib for PCL: libz via sb-alien (USER-RULED s516, TEMPORARY until pclxs) -- Compress::Zlib / IO::Compress::Gzip / Gunzip / IO::Zlib / Archive::Tar's compressed paths
